## Names

<a id="animate_scrolling_chars"></a>
### [`animate_scrolling_chars`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L12) `$2C70`

*routine*

Animates the background characters $61, $62 and $63 by rotating their 8-byte patterns (moving scenery that an actor can ride, state $17). Called by the frame handlers of rooms 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 11. anim_chars_delay is a frame delay: when it counts to 0, the patterns move one row (animate_scrolling_chars_step); bit 7 of anim_chars_delay is a pause of (value AND $7F) calls. The delays come from anim_step_delay indexed by anim_chars_speed_step (7 down to 0: 8, 6, 4, 2, 4, 6, 8, then a pause of 4); each delay lasts 16 rows (anim_chars_step_count). When anim_chars_speed_step passes 0 it restarts at 7 and anim_chars_direction flips.

<a id="animate_scrolling_chars_copy"></a>
### [`animate_scrolling_chars_copy`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L90) `$2CF1`

*label*

For the characters $63, $62, $61: copy their 8-byte pattern, rotated by anim_chars_phase rows. Pattern rows 0-3 go doubled to the 8 rows of the character (top half of a 2-line tile, through data_ptr), rows 4-7 go doubled to character + $80 (bottom half of the tile, $400 bytes higher, through row_ptr_bottom).

- **Jumped to from:** [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2CE2`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L78), [`animate_scrolling_chars`](animated_chars.md#animate_scrolling_chars) [`$2CE8`](../../../src/animated_chars.asm#L82)
